title: The Uniform Gromov Hausdorff Gap Problem for Approximating Spheres by Finite Homogeneous Spaces
summary: Let $S^n$ be the unit round sphere with its intrinsic angular metric, normalized so that $\operatorname{diam}S^n=π$. For finite homogeneous metric spaces $X$, put \[ δ_n=\inf_X d_{GH}(X,S^n). \] The main open problem is whether $\inf_{n\ge2}δ_n>0$. Gelander's theorem gives $δ_n>0$ in each fixed dimension, but not uniformly. An abstract cross-polytope construction gives the universal upper bound $δ_n\leπ/4$.
